title: PluginProcessor processBlock wiring - ScopedNoDenormals, smoothed reads, latency reporting, meter push, CMakeLists
description:
Phase-C fan-in and sole owner of Source/PluginProcessor.* and CMakeLists.txt. Wire ShredWidthEngine into the thin processor spine; register new sources for plugin and tests.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp from phases A–B (APVTS, prepareToPlay allocation hooks, bus layout, processBlock stub)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h (detuneAmount, delayL/R, monoXover, width, mix, latencyMode, outTrim, bypass, monoSource)
- Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.h public API from c.1 and MeterTap accessors
- CMakeLists.txt source lists / test target from phase B
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.9, 6, 7, 9.3–9.4, 13
- risk_notes: this task is sole Processor/CMakeLists owner; setLatencySamples = L/2; updateHostDisplay on mode switch

Implement:
1. PluginProcessor owns ShredWidthEngine (member). prepareToPlay calls engine.prepare(sampleRate, samplesPerBlock) and sets initial latency from latencyMode (Studio 1024 / Live 256).
2. processBlock:
   - juce::ScopedNoDenormals at top
   - if bypass: pass input→output (still honor channel layout / clear extras) without wet path, or true-bypass policy consistent with later tests
   - read smoothed parameters: crossover / coeffs dirty at block rate; width, mix, detune drift per sample (or engine-internal smoothers fed block targets); delayL/R, monoSource, outTrim as specified
   - apply monoSource Sum|Left; map detuneAmount to +cents / −cents; width 0–200% → [0,2]; mix 0–100% → [0,1]
   - call engine.process on the AudioBuffer
   - ensure final output pairs reach MeterTap (via engine) and optional outTrim dB at end
   - on latencyMode change: engine.setLatencyMode; setLatencySamples(engine.getReportedLatencySamples()); updateHostDisplay()
3. Expose engine/MeterTap read accessors needed later by the editor (correlation atomic load / FIFO drain hooks) without UI code here.
4. CMakeLists.txt only in this phase task:
   - Add Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp and Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.cpp to the ShredWidth plugin target
   - Add tests/EngineTests.cpp to the existing test executable and keep add_test
   - Do not remove VST3/CLAP/LV2/Standalone, unpin JUCE, or drop prior DSP sources

Do not implement GUI meters, do not author EngineTests bodies (c.4), do not rewrite DSP primitives.
acceptance_criteria: PluginProcessor owns/uses ShredWidthEngine and feeds smoothed APVTS parameters into the engine
setLatencySamples reports L/2 for the active latencyMode and updateHostDisplay is called on mode switch
Final output pairs are pushed to MeterTap (via engine path) on the audio thread
CMakeLists.txt registers Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp and Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.cpp on the plugin target
CMakeLists.txt registers tests/EngineTests.cpp on the test executable / add_test path
bypass and outTrim parameters are honored in the process path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/** implementation files (consume engine/meter APIs as written)
modify tests/EngineTests.cpp body (registration only via CMakeLists)
remove plugin formats or change JUCE pin
allocate on the audio thread or take locks in processBlock

allowed: thin processor that delegates DSP entirely to ShredWidthEngine
block-rate vs sample-rate smoother split matching §6
register EngineTests.cpp path even if empty-ish until c.4 fills it
